description: Compute the hex digest of UTF-8 text with any algorithm the Toolars hash-checker tools ship (md5, sha1, sha224, sha256, sha384, sha512). Defaults to sha256. Identical to the corresponding Toolars *-hash-checker web tools. MD5 and SHA-1 are integrity-only legacy digests, never signatures. Runs entirely locally; no network or filesystem access. Input and result enter the MCP client context and may be sent to its model provider.

algorithm.description: Digest algorithm. MD5 and SHA-1 are legacy integrity-only checks and are never signatures.

text.description: UTF-8 text to process. Nothing is read from files or URLs.

name: toolars_hash
